attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file New Hampshire Business Profits Tax (BPT) return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus ($109,000 gross income threshold).

condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "NH" streq } over if
apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "NH" streq } over if

action_details.action_postfix: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500
// Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate NH state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. NH uses static conformity to IRC as of December 31, 2018, and has decoupled from Section 163(j) interest limitations.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus with NH; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NH state additions and subtractions
action_details.action_postfix: // Calculate NH state additions and subtractions 0.0 /additions xdef 0.0 /subtractions xdef apportionment.state_additions additions xdef apportionment.state_subtractions subtractions xdef

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate NH Business Profits Tax (BPT). Applies NH 7.5% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted business profits.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus with NH; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NH BPT at 7.5% flat rate
